title: One Punch Man Vol. 1
author: One
description: Introduces Saitama, a hero who trained so hard he can defeat any enemy with one punch, leading to existential boredom and a search for a real challenge, all brought to life with Yusuke Murata's dynamic art, as he encounters monsters and eventually his cyborg disciple, Genos, setting up a superhero world full of strong but underwhelming heroes.
